summary.headline: Marcianus 336 Begins
summary.text: Catalog entries for Codex 8, including astrological calculations on illness, life and death, victory, and planetary hours, followed by a sailor’s work on stars causing storms. The description then begins Marcianus 336, formerly Bessarion’s, with notes on Persian and solar cycles, Maximus on heresies, and an index to the syntagma.
